rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The Congress of People's Deputies of the Russian Federation amends the RSFSR Constitution 'in connection with the change of the state's name' to 'Российская Федерация - Россия': Article 1 is restated (the names Russian Federation and Russia are equivalent); in the Constitution's title and preamble the old name and 'РСФСР' become 'Российской Федерации - России'; and in the headings of listed sections and chapters (including chapters '13-16') and in listed articles (including '102-123', the range holding Articles 121-1 to 121-11 on the President) the old name and 'РСФСР' are replaced by 'Российская Федерация' / 'Российской Федерации'. The office's constitutional title thereby reads 'Президент Российской Федерации'.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Point 50 restates Article 121-8 in terms of 'Президент Российской Федерации': the President issues decrees and orders on matters within his competence, his decrees are binding throughout the Russian Federation and may not contradict the Constitution and laws, and he may suspend acts of republic executives.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Point 63: the Law is put into effect from the day of its publication.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The published text ends 'Президент Российской Федерации Б.ЕЛЬЦИН, Москва, Кремль, 21 апреля 1992 года, N 2708-I'.
